02 — Design Guide

Design it step by step.

Pick a workflow and follow the steps in order. Each one explains what it does, what you need and the code targets, then opens the right calculator already filled from your room — save the result and the next step is ready.

03 — Design Pitfalls

What not to do — and what to do instead.

Common design and installation mistakes across HVAC, plumbing, fire, electrical and refrigeration, drawn beside the right way, with why they cause trouble, the rule that applies and the calculator to check it.

04 — Projects

Design room by room.

Add the rooms of a project once. Each calculator fills itself from the room and saves its result back — HVAC, electrical, plumbing & sanitary and fire protection, each with its own design chain and project totals.

05 — Estimate

Manual BOQ & BOM.

Type any project in yourself — divisions, groups and items with quantities and unit costs. The bill of quantities prices it in the usual QS format; the bill of materials lists the materials to buy. Export both to PDF or Excel.

06 — Utilities

Small tools. Big time savings.

Quick converters, data tables and field calculations you reach for between designs — pipe and wire data, slopes, offsets, tanks, heat and fluid properties — printable cheat sheets, and a few small games for a break.

07 — Codes & Standards

Where the numbers come from.

Every calculator, the method it uses and the code, standard or published source behind it — so you know what to check before a result goes into a design.

/

Nothing matches — try a code number (e.g. 62.1), a standard (NEC, SMACNA) or a calculator name.

How these references were compiled. The formulas and values in MechToolBox were written from established engineering knowledge of the standards listed here — they were not transcribed page by page from licensed copies. Editions differ, local amendments apply, and some values are typical rather than code-mandated. Always confirm against the edition your jurisdiction has adopted.

Standard method or value taken from the cited code Method recognised engineering formula Typical value representative data — verify for your project Rule of thumb quick estimate only

Standards & sources cited

    Regional codes & standards

      Local codes govern. In the Philippines, for example: the Philippine Mechanical Engineering Code, Philippine Electrical Code (Parts 1 & 2), Revised National Plumbing Code of the Philippines, Fire Code of the Philippines (RA 9514 and its IRR) and the National Building Code (PD 1096). Elsewhere, use the codes adopted by your authority having jurisdiction.

      09 — What's new

      Always growing.

      New calculators, drawings and tools land here first. Have an idea? Use the Feedback button.

      1. 2026-10-25

        Daily challenge, sun mode and shareable results

        • Spot the Mistake has a daily challenge — the same five drawings for everyone, with a shareable score.
        • Sun mode: a light theme that stays readable outdoors (sun button in the header).
        • Share link on every calculator sends your exact inputs to a colleague.
        • Six new calculators and printable cheat sheets.
        • Tidier header and footer, and a way to support the site.
      2. 2026-10-24

        Three more games and named parts in every pitfall

        • New games: Symbol Match, Phase Balance and Term Scramble.
        • Every Design Pitfalls drawing names its parts and says what it shows.
      3. 2026-10-23

        Design Pitfalls, utilities and games

        • Design Pitfalls: 116 drawn do / don’t examples with the rule and the why.
        • Utilities: pipe and wire data, slopes, offsets, tanks, air and water properties.
        • Search in Codes & Standards and Pitfalls; feedback goes straight to the developer.
        • App-style navigation and 17 new MEP calculators.
      4. 2026-10-13

        More calculators across MEPFS

        • New calculators in refrigeration, plumbing, fire protection and electrical — 85 in total at the time.
        • Design suggestions for the new calculators and a cleaner phone menu.
      5. 2026-10-12

        Price list, revisions and the design basis report

        • Six new calculators, a price list and revisions for estimates, the design basis report and the amber theme.
      6. 2026-10-08

        Design Guide, BOQ estimates and floating tools

        • Design Guide: step-by-step workflows for HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire.
        • Manual BOQ / BOM estimates, the floating unit converter and the ball compass with sun position.
        • A ✓ Pass / ⚠ Warning design check on 28 more calculators.
      7. 2026-10-07

        Projects and bills of quantities

        • Projects: rooms for every discipline, with a BOQ / BOM in the standard QS format.
